# dsh-egm · the gate before you build

> An elephant writes the spec, a goldfish tears it apart, you decide — then code gets written.
> Ada

pted from google/elephant-goldfish-model (Apache-2.0).
> A verbatim mirror of the upstream material

lives under `vendor/egm/`; the DSH adaptation is
> `skills/egm-gate` / `egm-review`, the `skills/egm
-classic-*` skeletons, and the dispatch mapping in `lib/`.
**Where things stand (read this first)**: the upstream material is saved and byte-verified against t
he pinned upstream commit (in the **source tree**; npm package contents differ slightly, see below),
but **the full upstream workflow, read-only isolation, and end-to-end runs have not been verified**
. Dispatch is refused by default; it can only run as an explicitly **non-isolated review** after you
authorize it via the reply prompt "Yes/Allow" click, the GUI "允许本轮评审" button, or type `/egm-review-
access 确认无隔离` (or `/egm-unsafe 确认无隔离` with the full confirmation phrase). **Real read-only has never
been proven, and the 0.1/0.2 releases marketed the gating as a "hard lock" — those claims have been
retracted, so any trust placed in the old docs is a bypass risk.** Commands, roles, and capabilitie
s described here follow `lib/dispatch.js` and `resources/classic-*.md` — the code changes.
## 0.8.6 Continue the Same Elephant and Use Direct Actions
The launch choice is remembered automatically. After the initial request is submitted, EGM removes i
ts owned `/egm` prefix; ordinary follow-up messages continue the same elephant and design. Task iden
tity, phase and command revisions are saved per session and workspace. The current-task panel can ex
plicitly archive the old task and wait for a new request. Revision numbers identify stale actions; t
hey are not an editing quota.
Present review results, source evidence and a concrete repair proposal before EGM-owned action butto
ns. No next-step questionnaire or second submit is required. Goldfish review independently; the elep
hant verifies findings and revises design documents. Revising a design does not authorize source-cod
e edits. The implementation action explicitly requests implementation within the approved scope. Dis
proven findings do not block progress, and unverified findings remain uncertain.
The adapted rules no longer impose two design revisions or one follow-up review per stage. Repeated
lack of progress calls for a concrete explanation and a revised approach. Actual review access expir
y and call counts remain separate. Task actions do not grant review permissions.
No tests are run for this update, as requested. Installation and hot-load receipts establish code de
livery; actual clicks and model behavior remain separate observations.

## The DSH adaptation (what runs, what does not)
`resources/classic-fidelity.md` is the authoritative list; summarized here:
**Adapted skills** (all `model-invocable: false`; they run only when you name them):
- `egm-classic-review` — the upstream five-phase review (phases 5–9). Stages 7 & 9 prioritize `egm_d
ispatch_batch` (concurrency: 3) with independent fresh synthesis; single roles use `egm_dispatch`. O
ne full five-phase pass = 9 dispatches, requiring mid-flow renewal after Stage 7. Intra-phase concur

rency does not equal end-to-end equivalence.
- `egm-classic-review-loop` — the adversarial loop (mul

ti-role batches prioritize `egm_dispatch_batch`, single roles use `egm_dispatch`).
- `egm-classic-br
ainstorm` — concept brainstorming: clarifying questions and anchored assumptions first, then dispatc
hed via `egm_dispatch_batch` across 6 lenses (concurrency: 3) and aggregated into `concepts_brief.md

` by independent fresh synthesis.
- `egm-classic-draft` — draft the design doc section-by-section, p

ausing for your approval after each section; no goldfish, no permit needed.
- `egm-classic-resolve`
— the elephant adjudication (CONTEST / ESCALATE / PROPOSE FIX / DECLINE); no goldfish, no permit nee

ded.
- `egm-classic-drift-report` — drift check; pure reads + a report, no goldfish.
- `egm-classic-
bootstrap` — repo documentation bootstrap: BFS directory scan, downgraded to serial batches.

**Dispatch channel & material control**:
- `egm_dispatch` for single role; `egm_dispatch_batch` for
1..6 tasks batch concurrent dispatch (default concurrency 3, max 3, shared snapshot, fresh synthesis

agent aggregation).
- `range={start,end}`: trims a genuine slice copy and maps original line number
s. Clarification: upstream review-loop used prompt-only instructions without strong trimming guarant
ee; local trimming is physical text slicing, but physical slicing is not system permission isolation

(`strictGoldfishReview:false`).
- `sources`: restricted strictly to regular files copied to room (d

irectories prohibited), minimal materials per role.
- `materials`: stage deliverables copied into re
view room (≤10 files).
[该节后续省略]
## What it is not

- **Not a smarter reviewer.** By default it is the same model with a fresh context.
- **Not exhausti

ve**, and **no promises about review speed or file counts**.
- **Not a code writer.** Spec and criti

que only.
- **Commands and `model-invocable` flags are not hard limits.**
- **Not a lossless replica
of upstream**: the tool explicitly denies equivalence.
## Untested limitations — honest list

- **No real end-to-end run of the full workflow.**
- **Read-only is unverified, with a legacy-claims

bypass risk.**
- **Path reference standard**: `resources/`, `agents/`, `vendor/` are relative to pl
ugin package root, not SKILL.md directory. Missing files must be reviewed via absolute inventory lis

t, never hallucinated.
- **Working elephant animation**: real working-state animation in conversatio

n, but live-machine acceptance must not be claimed.
- **0.8.3 Interactive & filtering live acceptanc
e**: Dedicated reply button clicks, elephant mode control command filtering, and streamlined kickoff
messages have aligned specifications, but plain typing does not authorize; live clicks, command int
erception, and rendering on actual DSH browser pages remain unverified.
